To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the recording of the research procedures using a smartphone is a feasible and practical way to provide a detailed description of the research procedures; (b) the recording of participants’ behavior is also feasible, but requires a more detailed discussion of the ethical issues and threats to internal validity; (c) the recording of both procedures and participants would be a valuable resource to facilitate replication, and would also increase accountability by providing more transparency and a detailed record of the research procedures.

the use of audio/video recordings of experimental protocols and participants can facilitate replication and accountability, and that the use of such recordings should be considered as part of the research protocol.
